suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add note about CORS testing: When testing CORS middleware with FastAPI TestClient, the Origin header must be provided in the request for CORS middleware to add response headers (access-control-allow-origin). Without an Origin header, the middleware assumes the request is from the same origin and doesn't add CORS headers.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: CORS tests initially failed because they didn't include Origin header. Tests were fixed by adding headers={'Origin': 'http://localhost:3000'} to requests.
